_about: Everything that will be sent to Play for this app. Stage 1 fills it (analyze derives, Claude answers the rest with evidence = archivo:línea or build output, and rule = Google's page). Stage 2 shows it to the user. Stage 3 sends exactly this. Never type an answer in the console that is not here.

tester_message.label: Message to the testers (with the opt-in link)

app_access_instructions.label: Instructions for Google's reviewer (only if part of the app needs access)

privacy_policy.question: Privacy policy URL (Policy > App content > Privacy policy)

app_access.question: App access: is all functionality available without special access (login, membership, location, code)?

ads.question: Ads: does the app contain ads (including from SDKs and house ads)?

advertising_id.question: Advertising ID: does the app use the advertising ID (AD_ID permission)?

content_rating.question: Content rating (IARC questionnaire): category and every answer (violence, sexuality, language, controlled substances, user interaction / chat, shares location, digital purchases, unrestricted internet, gambling, user-generated content)

target_audience.question: Target audience: age groups, and whether the app could unintentionally appeal to children

data_safety.question: Data safety: does the app collect or share any of the required user data types? (false = none; otherwise the CSV says which)

foreground_services.question: Foreground service types to declare (each with a description and a video of its use)

sensitive_permissions.question: Sensitive permissions that need a declaration form

government_app.question: Is it a government app (made by or for a government)?
